-- models/staging/stg_unpivoted_orders.sql



WITH source_orders AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM "neondb"."public"."raw_orders"

),

unpivoted AS (

    SELECT
        o.order_form_no,
        o.order_date,
        o.buyer_name,
        o.buyer_location,
        o.s_no,
        o.style_number,
        o.unit_price,
        o.line_item_total,
        o.total_qty_line_item,
        o.ingested_at,
        u.size,
        u.quantity_ordered AS quantity
    FROM source_orders o
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        VALUES
            ('18', o.size_18_qty),
            ('20', o.size_20_qty),
            ('22', o.size_22_qty),
            ('24', o.size_24_qty),
            ('26', o.size_26_qty),
            ('28', o.size_28_qty),
            ('30', o.size_30_qty),
            ('32', o.size_32_qty),
            ('34', o.size_34_qty),
            ('36', o.size_36_qty),
            ('38', o.size_38_qty),
            ('40', o.size_40_qty),
            ('42', o.size_42_qty)
    ) AS u(size, quantity_ordered)

)

SELECT *
FROM unpivoted
WHERE quantity > 0

-- models/marts/fact_material_requirements.sql

 -- Final models are often tables for performance

SELECT
    o.order_form_no,
    o.order_date,
    o.buyer_name,
    o.buyer_location,
    o.s_no,
    o.style_number,
    CAST(o.size AS INT) AS size, -- Cast size_text back to INT for joining
    o.quantity, -- Renamed from quantity_ordered in staging
    b.material_type,
    b.material_qty_per_unit,
    b.unit_of_measure,
    -- Calculate total material needed for this line item
    o.quantity * b.material_qty_per_unit AS total_material_needed_for_line_item,
    o.ingested_at AS order_ingested_at
FROM
    "neondb"."staging"."stg_unpivoted_orders" o -- Reference our staging model
JOIN
    "neondb"."public"."raw_bill_of_materials" b -- Reference the BOM source
ON
    o.style_number = b.style_number
    AND CAST(o.size AS INT) = b.size -- Cast to INT for join
WHERE
    o.quantity > 0

-- models/marts/fct_order_fulfillment.sql



WITH orders AS (
    SELECT * FROM "neondb"."staging"."stg_unpivoted_orders"
),

prod_logs AS (
    SELECT * FROM "neondb"."staging"."stg_production_logs"
),

shipping_logs AS (
    SELECT * FROM "neondb"."staging"."stg_shipping_logs"
),

latest_prod AS (
    SELECT 
        order_form_no,
        stage AS current_production_stage,
        updated_at AS last_stage_updated_at
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_form_no ORDER BY updated_at DESC) as rn
        FROM prod_logs
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
    o.order_form_no,
    o.order_date,
    o.buyer_name,
    o.buyer_location,
    o.style_number,
    SUM(o.quantity) as total_order_quantity,
    MAX(lp.current_production_stage) as current_production_stage,
    MAX(lp.last_stage_updated_at) as last_stage_updated_at,
    MAX(EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - lp.last_stage_updated_at)) AS days_in_current_stage,
    CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_shipped,
    MAX(s.shipped_at) AS shipped_at,
    MAX(s.courier) AS courier,
    MAX(s.tracking_number) AS tracking_number,
    CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN s.shipped_at IS NULL AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - lp.last_stage_updated_at) > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BOOLEAN) AS is_delayed
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN latest_prod lp ON o.order_form_no = lp.order_form_no
LEFT JOIN shipping_logs s ON o.order_form_no = s.order_form_no
GROUP BY 
    o.order_form_no,
    o.order_date,
    o.buyer_name,
    o.buyer_location,
    o.style_number
